evidence.section: Splunk product compatibility matrix — App 8.8.0 row, on-premises and Cloud columns
evidence.statement: The exact App 8.8.0 row lists SOAR on-premises 8.8.0 and a second literal value 8..0. The second value cannot identify a tested version. The separate Cloud column explicitly lists 8.8.0 and 8.7.0; it cannot fill the malformed on-premises cell.

documentRevision.qualification: Direct public response bytes. Exact publisher revision unknown.

title: App for SOAR 8.8.0 matrix has a malformed on-premises version
problem: The second SOAR on-premises value in the functionality-tested App 8.8.0 row is printed as 8..0.

products: Splunk App for SOAR and SOAR on-premises
exclusions: No additional deployment, version, entitlement, authorization or fix is inferred.

scopeComparison: The adjacent Cloud column lists 8.7.0 explicitly. Its value cannot resolve the separate on-premises column.

impact.customerScenario: Selecting an exact SOAR on-premises version to use with App for SOAR 8.8.0.
impact.consequence: The malformed cell cannot be used to select a tested on-premises version.

confidence.rationale: The exact matrix cell was observed directly; its intended value is unknown.

lifecycle.reason: The second on-premises cell requires authoritative correction.
